summary: Iteration 8 - verified 3 fixes: Inventory stock decrement/restore + borrower info; Classes creation by role=guru; Attendance manual NISN + recognition panel. Backend pytest 9/9 passed (stock 5->3 on approve, ->5 on return, reject-after-approve restores to 4, over-borrow returns 400 'Stok tidak cukup', requester_role/kelas/nisn/email captured on POST /api/borrow, guru can POST /api/classes /api/assignments /api/quizzes, POST /api/attendance/scan with {nisn} matches siswa.demo, missing both returns 400, invalid NISN returns 404). Frontend verified against public URL: guru sees create-class-button visible on /classes; admin Approval Peminjaman tab renders borrow-request-{id} rows with borrower-info-{id} containing 'Siswa Demo · Siswa · Kelas XI IPA 1 · NISN 0099887766'; /attendance manual-nisn-input + manual-nisn-submit posts scan and shows recognition-panel with recognition-name='Siswa Demo', kelas XI IPA 1, NISN, HADIR badge.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/borrow/{bid} passes status as a query param instead of request body - unusual REST style but functional; consider a Pydantic body for consistency.

In update_borrow, the item lookup uses only {id: item_id} without dscope, so a staff_tu could theoretically approve requests for items outside their demo scope; low risk because borrow list is already scoped. Non-blocking.
server.py now >1720 lines - still recommend splitting into routers per domain (auth/users/inventory/attendance/classes/etc). Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: TEST_iter8_item, TEST_iter8_reject inventory items created & auto-cleaned in tests; TEST_iter8_kelas_guru class created & deleted; TEST_iter8_tugas assignment and TEST_iter8_quiz remain (small, isolated to demo scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use _load_url() pattern in test file to source REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env when env var isn't inherited by pytest runner. PATCH /api/borrow/{bid} takes status as a QUERY parameter (?status=Disetujui), not JSON body.
